cohort: 100 pregnant women with active epilepsy using anti-epileptic drugs (AEDs) before and during pregnancy and 100 pregnant women with seizures 5 years or more before pregnancy but not using AEDs during pregnancy.
finding: Pregnancy course is uncomplicated and neonatal outcome is good in the majority of women with active epilepsy with proper antenatal and neurologic care.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at enrolment was 14.5 weeks (range 5 to 38 weeks).
